plain: In a way that cannot be disputed

webster.text: In a manner to preclude debate; indisputably; incontrovertibly; indubitably.

example.quote: Yet enough appears to show incontestably that San Marino is by no means a perfect democracy.
example.cite: John Adams, A Defence of the Constitutions of Government of the United States of America, vol. 1 (London, 1787), ch. 1
